name: Elena Popescu
bio:
Elena Popescu's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for mechanics and a fierce competitive spirit honed on local go-kart tracks. After graduating with a degree in engineering, she worked her way up through the ranks of smaller racing teams, mastering the intricacies of car setup and race strategy. Her exceptional ability to motivate her team and extract maximum performance from limited resources caught the eye of Anderson Racing's management. 

As Team Principal, Elena is known for her meticulous preparation and data-driven decision-making. She believes in empowering her engineers and drivers, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and contributes their best. Her focus is not just on winning races, but also on building a sustainable team culture that can consistently challenge for championships. Elena is distinctive for her ability to blend technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills, a rare combination in the high-pressure world of motorsport.

physical.description: Elena is of average height with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a lucky wrench charm on her keychain.
Insists on having a specific type of herbal tea before every race.
Known to sketch out aerodynamic concepts on napkins during team meetings.
